description:
What is This Part?
This is the Hose that goes from the Filler Cap throat to the Gas Tank.
Comes with Both Required Clamps
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Inlet Hose
Qty 1 – Upper Hose Clamp (2.25″)
Qty 1 – Lower Hose Clamp (2″)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
